summary: All 6 round-1 objections genuinely resolved with proof in both ticket-20260513-090000.md and context-20260513-090000.json. BA promoted Bug 4 from deferred to W7 (mechanical refactor with 9 enumerated helpers <=30 lines each in scripts/lib/render_day_data.py + byte-identical merged-dict invariant per codex round-2 Q1). BA promoted Bug 10 from no-op to W8 (schema-reject path via agent-scoped BANNED_AD_HOC_KEYS extension + _normalize_to_canonical_record shape-normalizer, with codex round-2 Q2 'accept-but-ignore = silent-data-loss trap' ruling explicitly honored). AC1 and AC3 amended with runnable curl|grep text-grep fallback recipes. AC-DISPATCH section + orchestrator_dispatch_contract object document the env-var clause + worker entry verification + alternative sentinel-file path. Bug 7 evidence section + AC6 corrected to 'loud exit 1 with Unknown option <plan-id>' (not silent). AC5 explicitly rejects absolute-symlink-commit branch, requires relative-symlink OR path-constant migration + clean-checkout portability test. File-disjointness re-audit confirms 8-worker plan: W2+W7 share generate-html-interactive.py with W7-after-W2 sequential declared; W5+W8 share save_translate.py with W8-after-W5 sequential declared; all other 6 workers remain file-disjoint. All 13 ACs (AC1-AC13 + AC-DISPATCH) are runnable by next-cycle QA without ambiguity.
